source_instruction: i am looking for dark denim color ethylene vinyl ultra train of size 10, 3rd generation for  men
query: I stopped at the food cart right outside the mall entrance on my way in, and the guy working there was grilling up these spicy mango chicken skewers that smelled so good I almost bailed on my whole errand to sit on the curb and eat a whole plate. A golden retriever trotted by with its owner while I was lingering, carrying a tiny neon tennis ball in its mouth that matched the bright orange awning over the pretzel stand a few storefronts down, and it stopped to wag at me like it knew I was already fighting the urge to blow my budget on snacks instead of the thing I came for. The weather’s been so weird lately too—one minute it’s pouring rain so hard you can’t see across the parking lot, the next the sun’s blazing so bright you’re squinting and regretting leaving your sunglasses in the car, so my walk over had me dodging puddles and wiping sweat off my forehead in equal measure. I’m looking through the men’s athletic shoes here, and I’ve heard pairs made with ethylene vinyl material, right? I’ve heard about the one that’s got that dark wash and bright pop colorway people keep talking about, y’know? I’ve also heard those pairs align with the usual size I have for my casual kicks, and I’ve heard none of those options ring in over 120 bucks total.
